subject: Life Skills
title: Budgeting With the 50/30/20 Rule
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Budgeting With the 50/30/20 Rule.

hook.text: Senator Elizabeth Warren popularized a budgeting rule so simple it fits on a sticky note.

buildup.text: Most budgeting systems fail because they demand tracking every dollar. That's exhausting and unsustainable.

discovery.text: 50% of income goes to needs, 30% to wants, and 20% to savings and debt repayment.

twist.text: The hard part is separating needs from wants. Your phone is a need. The premium plan might be a want.

climax.text: Automate the 20% to savings first. Spend the rest knowing the important part is already handled.

punchline.text: Save first, spend second. Freedom follows.

quiz.question: In the 50/30/20 rule, what does the 20% go toward?
